acceptance.criterion: pixel7 exhibit-contract verafin still canvas: root cause, 20 local repeats with 0 failures under 3 workers
acceptance.result: pass (fixed in the test; 3 green CI runs still to come)
acceptance.evidence: Root cause is in the measurement, not the app. Reproduced 2 of 30 locally with the old capture: the hash went A, B, A while stats().frames, camera position and look-at held still. The diff between A and B was 1 in 255 on 114,548 pixels, all outside the 55% transparent core of the CSS vignette (0 of 1.13M inside it): a device-scale screenshot at Pixel 7's DPR 2.625 captures Chromium's re-raster of the radial-gradient overlay and its upscale of the 412 x 839 drawing buffer (DPR 1 under ?test=1), both of which vary between composited frames. Hiding the vignette left 3 to 8 pixel 1-in-255 diffs from the upscale (11 of 40 runs). canvasPixels() captures at scale css, one pixel per buffer pixel, and asserts the PNG size equals canvas.width x height, so every rendered pixel is still compared byte-exact: 0 of 240 captures in 40 runs varied, then 20 of 20 contract repeats passed. Desktop (DPR 1) never showed it. exhibits.spec idle-motion and reduced-motion checks use the same helper (20 of 20 pass), so compositor noise can no longer fake motion either.
